output_text: Hello! I'm here to assist you today and I'm an AI assistant. While I can't access any personal account details, I'm happy to provide information about Helix Bank's products and services, and help guide you to the appropriate resources. If you need to share personal information, I'll happily direct you to authenticated channels like our mobile app or secure phone line at 1-800-HELIX-CS. How can I assist you further?<|im_end|>
